== Notes ==
* Judgment Strike is a single [[attack]] that can [[hit]] multiple foes.
** When wielding a scythe, each target will only be hit once.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to hit [[kiting]] opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
* The damage type of the base attack is converted to armor-respecting holy damage for this attack, resulting in double damage to [[undead]] but voiding any damage boost from skills such as [[Conjure Frost]].

==Trivia==
*This skill uses the same icon as the ''[[Guild Wars 2]]'' [[gw2:Firebrand|Firebrand]] skill [[gw2:Echo of Truth|Echo of Truth]].
*Judgment Strike is the only attack skill among all [[caster]] profession skills.
*Added to the game with the [[Feedback:Game updates/20200422|22nd April 2020 update]] as part of the 15th [[Anniversary Celebration]].
*The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
